reasons.plausibility: Surface-segregation-driven premelting in alloy nanoparticles is well-supported by existing theory and evidence.
reasons.testability: Comparing passivated and unpassivated nanoparticles under in-situ TEM and EDS provides a straightforward, decisive test of the proposed mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a clear mechanistic explanation and a direct experimental approach that is highly relevant for controlling nanoparticle thermal stability.
